title: 175B parameters
diagram_summary: Comparison of GPT model sizes showing parameter counts and decoder layers across three versions: GPT-1 (117M parameters, 12 decoders, 512 token size), GPT-2 (1.5B parameters, 48 decoders, 1024 token size), and GPT-3 (175B parameters, 96 decoders, 2048 token size).
